name: prata0x-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code skills and agents

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Delegate read-only review/investigation tasks to GitHub Copilot CLI or OpenAI Codex CLI directly, trigger the autonomous copilot -> codex -> opus fallback chain for a second opinion, or manually escalate one specific task to Fable or Opus via /fable or /opus.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Occasional, project-wide audit skills (comments, product/agent-friction issues, security) and a skill that turns their high-confidence findings into GitHub issues. No hooks — periodic deep audits only, not commit-time gates.

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Deep, skeptical review of a caller-specified diff range using parallel scanner agents (correctness/regressions, design/maintainability, test coverage) plus a confidence filter — for moments needing more scrutiny than the global reviewer subagent alone, e.g. before a deploy.

plugins.name: response-quality
plugins.description: Stop hook (type: prompt) that judges whether the final response is written in Japanese, and forces a redo when it isn't.

plugins.name: notify-sound
plugins.description: Plays a Windows notification sound from WSL on turn end and on AskUserQuestion.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writer skills for technical docs, dev artifacts (commits/PRs/issues), changelogs, meeting notes, and translations, each with a built-in check against generic AI-generated-prose patterns; plus a pre-write context nudge, a fixed-phrase mechanical hook, and an occasional project-wide audit skill for absence-of-writer/rhythm issues.

plugins.name: blog-pipeline
plugins.description: Write -> review -> translate -> review pipeline for AI-authored blog articles in a site-specific fictional persona voice, parameterized per site by a PERSONA.md convention. Reuses the writing plugin's style-audit agents; adds a fact-checker agent for technical accuracy and translation fidelity.
